items.text: nahi ye mera number nahi hai
haan ji sahi pakde hain
waha se call nahi kiya maine

items.context: Sir is this your registered phone number
items.text: nahi wo mera number nahi hai

items.context: Can you please confirm your name for the account
items.text: wrong person yeh toh mera dost ka number hai

items.context: Are you calling regarding loan repayment
items.text: ye loan mera nahi hai
accha bhaiya shayad aap galat number pe call kar rahe ho
umm matlab mera naam to alag hai aur phone number bhi alag hai
haan ji main samajh sakta hoon par yeh mera account nahi hai
nahi nahi yeh amount to maine transfer hi nahi kiya hai
woh aapne galti se kisi aur ko call kar liya lagta hai
kal nahi aaj call karna tha par mujhse nahi hua call karna
ye loan mujhe nahi lena tha mai paise bhi nahi bheja

items.context: Please confirm your date of birth for account verification
items.text: main to abhi thoda confuse hoon aap check kar lo dob sahi hai kya

items.context: Did you apply for a personal loan recently
items.text: nahi ji maine kabhi aise kisi loan ke liye apply nahi kiya

items.context: Is this phone number registered with your account
items.text: ye number mera nahi hai ye galat dikh raha hai system me

items.context: Can you confirm if you are account holder
items.text: umm sorry shayad galat samjhe ho main account holder nahi hoon

items.context: Have you contacted us from this number before
items.text: maine toh is number se kabhi call nahi kiya hai aapse
bhaiya mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki aap kiski baat kar rahe ho mera naam to alag hai aur account bhi
haan ji main Mumbai me rehta hoon mera naam Rajesh hai aur yeh number mera bhi nahi hai jo aap baar baar call kar rahe hain
accha samajh gaye mujhe lagta hai aapne galti se mujhe call kar liya hai kyunki main is transaction se bilkul anjaan hoon

items.context: Can you please state your full name for verification
items.text: main aapke system ko verify karne ke liye bata doon ke mera naam Rahul hai aur ye number mera nahi hai

items.context: Are you the person associated with this loan account
items.text: nahi ji ye loan ka case nahi hai main bank ka customer hoon par jiska number aap dial kar rahe ho wo main nahi hoon

items.context: We found an overdue balance on your account can you confirm details
items.text: sorry mujhe lag raha hai ki aap galat aadmi ko call kar rahe hain kyunki ye details meri nahi hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: wrong_person - says the agent has the wrong person or number
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
